validate_protobuf_message: validate a protobuf message against protoc-gen-validate rules and return validation errors
print_validate_generated_code: print the generated validation code for a given protobuf message instance
check_field_has_validate: check if a protobuf field descriptor has validate.rules options attached
validate_hostname: validate a hostname string for correct format and length constraints
validate_email_address: validate an email address for format, length, and hostname correctness
